correctness.rationale: For n>=3, order-preserving decreasing f with f^2=epsilon has an initial fiber [m] mapping to 1, and all image values <=m; this yields |S_n|=2^(n-2). If h=v∘u is nonzero, the s(h) distinct nonunit h-values need s(h) distinct u-intermediates strictly above m(v), implying m(h)>=M(h)+s(h). Conversely choose u(i)=M+j for each nonunit h-value t_j and v(M+j)=t_j, with initial 1-fibers of lengths m and M: these maps are in S_n and compose to h whenever m>=M+s. Counts by distinct values and suffix runs give generating function sum b_n z^n=z(1-z)/(1-2z+z^2-z^3); nilpotency and indecomposability force the unique minimal generating set S_n\S_n^2 and rank=2^(n-2)-b_n. Independent complete compositions n=3..8 match b_n and rank, including rank(S_6)=9; proof is all-n and finite enumeration corroborative.
residual_risks: Only f^2=epsilon, not higher-potency nilpotent ideals.
